# Wan Animate

> > Wan Animate is an AI-powered character animation and video replacement platform that transforms images into animated videos with motion transfer and facial expression capabilities.

Wan Animate leverages advanced AI technologies including Mixture-of-Experts and Relighting LoRA to enable creators to generate character animations from static images. The platform offers flexible pricing with credits-based subscriptions and commercial licensing options.

## Key Topics

- AI character animation
- Video replacement technology
- Image-to-video generation
- Motion transfer
- Facial expression transfer
- Mixture-of-Experts architecture
- Relighting LoRA
- AI video generator
- Character animation tools
- Commercial licensing
- Credits-based pricing
- Video creation workflows
